# krebe.dev

> Personal site of Solomon Ekrebe, a software developer making complex things feel simple.

Solomon Ekrebe is a software developer at Spark Plugin. This single-page site introduces his work, professional story, and contact details. The story covers a banking background, product engineering experience, and building tools used by thousands of Squarespace designers.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.krebe.dev/): Hero, professional story, and contact block.
- [Full site content](https://www.krebe.dev/llms-full.txt): Complete homepage copy in Markdown for AI agents.
